title: What's Cooking in Business Central: Financial Report Scheduling

features.name: Financial Report Scheduling
features.description: A new feature that allows users to send financial reports automatically on a recurring schedule. Reports can be exported to Excel, PDF, and emailed to nominated recipients based on a configured schedule.
features.status_evidence_quote: when it releases in the near future

features.name: Export to Excel and PDF
features.description: The ability to automatically export financial reports to both Excel and PDF formats as part of the scheduled delivery. Reports are sent to the report inbox in both formats.
features.status_evidence_quote: when it releases in the near future

features.name: Email Delivery to Recipients
features.description: Financial reports can be automatically emailed to nominated recipients as part of the scheduled delivery. Users select specific recipients to receive the scheduled reports.
features.status_evidence_quote: when it releases in the near future

features.name: Report Scheduling Controls
features.description: The next run date time field allows selecting when the report will first be sent, and the recurrence run date formula determines the cadence following that. This enables flexible scheduling of recurring reports.
features.status_evidence_quote: when it releases in the near future

features.name: Report Inbox and Logs
features.description: Users receive scheduled reports in their report inbox which can be accessed using the logs action. This provides a central location to view all sent reports.
features.status_evidence_quote: when it releases in the near future

features.name: Custom Filters for Schedules
features.description: Reporting options and filters can be set up that are specific to each schedule using custom filters. This allows different configurations for different scheduled instances of the same report.
features.status_evidence_quote: when it releases in the near future

features.name: Date Filter Formulas
features.description: Start and end date filter formulas can be applied to a financial report schedule, allowing selection of a date filter different to the default date filter on the financial report.
features.status_evidence_quote: when it releases in the near future
